decisions.reason: The safety shoe line is core business for this large manufacturer, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, slack lets it keep maturing.

The comfort insole is a cheap complement that supports shoe sales, and since Product F's withdrawal has already pruned the insole range, further consolidation is less pressing despite its low visibility.

The supportive insole still fits the foot-measurement and tailored-solution offer, but its overlap with the comfort insole and its mere mention keep it the likeliest pruning candidate if search for better resource uses continues.
The ergonomic series has its own page and embodies the firm's innovation direction, so management would keep committing to it while results build.
Firefighter and rescue boots serve a certification-driven niche with long procurement cycles, so two years is too short to judge them against aspirations and slack lets the firm carry them.
